The MSCI ACWI IMI Robotics & AI Filtered index tracks companies from developed and emerging markets worldwide which are either involved in the development of artificial intelligence and robotics, or likely to profit from these developments. The stocks included are filtered according to ESG criteria (environmental, social and corporate governance). The parent index is the MSCI ACWI IMI.

LU1971906802.name: UBS EURO STOXX 50 ESG UCITS ETF EUR dis
LU1971906802.description: The UBS EURO STOXX 50 ESG UCITS ETF EUR dis seeks to track the EURO STOXX® 50 ESG index. The EURO STOXX® 50 ESG index tracks companies from Eurozone countries. It excludes companies that do not comply with the principles of the UN Global Compact (controversial weapons, tobacco, consumers and producers of fossil energy sources).

LU2009147757.name: Xtrackers S&P 500 Swap UCITS ETF 1D
LU2009147757.description: The Xtrackers S&P 500 Swap UCITS ETF 1D seeks to track the S&P 500® index. The S&P 500® index tracks the 500 largest US stocks.

LU2009202107.name: Amundi MSCI Emerging Ex China UCITS ETF Acc
LU2009202107.description: The Amundi MSCI Emerging Ex China UCITS ETF Acc seeks to track the MSCI Emerging Markets ex China index. The MSCI Emerging Markets ex China index tracks stocks from emerging markets worldwide excluding China.

LU2263803533.name: Xtrackers MSCI World Swap UCITS ETF 1D
LU2263803533.description: The Xtrackers MSCI World Swap UCITS ETF 1D seeks to track the MSCI World index. The MSCI World index tracks stocks from 23 developed countries worldwide.

LU3098954871.name: TEQ - General Artificial Intelligence R EUR UCITS ETF (Acc)
LU3098954871.description: The TEQ - General Artificial Intelligence R EUR UCITS ETF (Acc) seeks to track the TEQ – General Artificial Intelligence index. The TEQ – General Artificial Intelligence index tracks the performance of companies worldwide that are engaged in the field of artificial intelligence.

NL0011683594.name: VanEck Morningstar Developed Markets Dividend Leaders UCITS ETF
NL0011683594.description: The VanEck Morningstar Developed Markets Dividend Leaders UCITS ETF seeks to track the Morningstar Developed Markets Large Cap Dividend Leaders Screened Select index. The Morningstar Developed Markets Large Cap Dividend Leaders index tracks the performance of companies that display consistency and sustainability in dividend payment patterns and is composed of the top yielding securities which satisfy the screening criteria. Only stocks from developed countries are included in the index. The stocks included are filtered according to ESG criteria (environmental, social and corporate governance).
